query: Suggest the skills and rules this project needs
expected_behavior: Collects the fingerprint and launches one devkit:code-reader per layer concurrently in one message
Every row of the proposal table has evidence such as file:line, commits or fingerprint numbers, with at most 3 recommended
Creates no files before the user chooses

query: Look at fix commits since last month and find rules to add
expected_behavior: Recollects the fingerprint with a --since baseline and reads the fix commit diffs
Drops candidates already in docs/rules, and reports only the difference where rules and code disagree
Adds only the chosen rows in the existing style

query: I build screens from design specs every time. Should we make this a skill?
expected_behavior: Keeps the common analyze/develop flow and proposes a skill that adds only this repo's own steps per the project-flow blueprint
If chosen, creates 3+ evals per skill-authoring.md and checks with check_skill.py
Adds one line to the Project skills and agents section of CLAUDE.md
